resources.string: No photos yet — tap ↻ near the camera
Bluetooth permission is needed to wake the camera. Tap Sync on the main screen to allow it.

Stand within about 10 m of the camera and tap Sync.\n\nThe app wakes the camera over Bluetooth, then Android asks once to join the camera\'s own Wi-Fi. Photos are copied to the phone, so the gallery and the home-screen widget keep working when you walk away.
